_comment: Every number that turns a model score into a screening recommendation lives here. Reasoning: docs/models/risk_policy.md. The decision threshold itself comes from each model's model_card.json. refer_when_positive / refer_when_uncertain decide whether a result SUGGESTS asking a specialist. referral_advice.queue_automatically lists the recommendations that are put in the specialist queue without the health worker pressing anything (default: 'consider', i.e. borderline results and usable photos with quality warnings, as in the proposal's sequence diagram); clear positives ('recommended') are sent by the health worker with 'Ask a specialist'; clear negatives ('none') are not queued. referral_advice.urgent_from_band: a DR estimated band at or above this makes the default priority urgent. referral_advice.low_quality_photo is the recommendation when every model is negative but the photo has quality warnings. severity_bands=false gives a binary result with no 1-5 band.

recommendations.low: No signs detected. Recommend routine screening at the next scheduled visit.
recommendations.medium: Borderline result. Queued for specialist review; retake the photo if it was poor.
recommendations.high: Signs detected. Refer the patient to an eye specialist.

recommendations.low: No signs of diabetic retinopathy detected. Recommend routine annual diabetic eye screening.
recommendations.medium: Borderline diabetic retinopathy score. Queued for specialist review.
recommendations.high: Signs of diabetic retinopathy detected. Referral to an eye specialist is recommended.

recommendations.low: No signs of glaucoma detected. Continue routine eye checks.
recommendations.medium: Borderline glaucoma result. Queued for specialist review.
recommendations.high: Signs suggestive of glaucoma detected. Refer to an eye specialist for assessment.

recommendations.medium: Borderline cataract result. Queued for specialist review.
recommendations.high: Signs suggestive of cataract detected. Refer to an eye specialist for assessment.
